raceFix: Cause: pickNode built `spec`, the state's board, while the node picker already listed the picked board's labels (`picked`, one frame before load). A second cause, also present on 00e6a4c: the board picker's value followed the state only. Svelte writes a select only when its value changes, so a load that ended a pick on the shown board left the picker on the picked board. Changes: (1) pickNode builds on `pickerSpec`, the board whose labels the node picker lists. It refuses any label not in `pickerLabels` (also covers Number('') = 0). (2) A new `aim` state ({spec, node|null}) is set in build() at the reader's choice and cleared by load(). The selects' values are now boardValue = aim?.spec ?? spec and nodeValue = picked?.node ?? aim?.node ?? nodeLabel. build() calls flushSync() so that two choices in one task still move the selects. A pick of another board in the window resets `picked`, so the node picker lists the shown board again until the new labels are known. The options markup is unchanged: still written at the `picked` step. Resulting rule: a node from the old list cancels the board pick (state A2 node 2, both pickers A2/2); a node from the new list builds on the new board (E6 node 3). Evidence: the new test 'a node chosen while a pick builds is built on the board whose labels the node picker lists, and the pickers show it' fails on a 68d93ef build (state-board 'A2', expected 'E6') and passes after. Races: 8 of 24 fail before, 0 of 24 after. The reviewer's race.mjs gives E6 node 3, pickers E6 and 3/6, no error. Other controls checked: relation, relation-i, matrix-node, start, board node, table button, undo button, key u. In the pick's first frame they act on the shown state and the pick then replaces it; the typed start loads a state and so ends the pick. From the next frame their panels are taken down. Settled states and server HTML are unchanged.
buildingLine: Fixed with its own test. load() now clears `building`, `aim` and `picked`, so any load (link by popstate, typed start, the pick's own end) ends a pick in progress. Test 'a link or a typed start that loads a state while a pick builds ends the pick: its line goes and the pickers show the state' covers popstate to ?g=D4&k=2 in the window and in the pick's task, and a typed start (2, 0) in the pick's task. It fails on 68d93ef (the 'Building E6.' line is left) and passes after. Not changed: a popstate whose state equals the shown state is still ignored by readLink, so the pick continues and the URL keeps the link until the reader acts (history layer rule). Ending the pick there would also cancel picks on all 12 M8 instances whenever a fragment link fires popstate.
longTask: Root, --repeat-each 20 --workers 1, four alternating batches each, one-minute load 0.79-2.11. handoff: Only T12's own files changed; no engine, history-layer, hook, link-key or contract file. Behaviour while a pick builds: (a) the pickers show the pick from the reader's choice; (b) a node is built on the board whose labels the node picker lists, so a node from the old list cancels the board pick; (c) any load ends the pick and clears its line. All settled output is identical to 68d93ef. Size is 87910 of 90000 B, leaving about 2.1 kB. Left as is (history layer): a popstate to the shown state during a pick is ignored and the URL lags until the reader acts. pickNode's refusal does not reset the select's DOM; only a script within one task can reach it. Scratch scripts and logs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-mutation-game/03d88ee7-3b55-5f84-9822-84f78aad9733/scratchpad/P5-A2-G5-repair-2/: races.sh with races2.mjs, rv-race.mjs, rv-link-race.mjs, compare.sh, longtask.sh, trace-ab.sh, trace-sum.mjs. The race and compare scripts need node_modules, which have been deleted; run npm ci first.
